stem:
The table shows the diagonal lengths of TV screens at a store.

TV Screen Diagonal Lengths

| Screen | Length (feet) |
|--------|--------------|
| W      | \(\sqrt{12.25}\) |
| X      | \(2\tfrac{1}{6}\) |
| Y      | \(\frac{37}{\sqrt{144}}\) |
| Z      | \(\frac{8}{3}\) |

Which TV screen has the smallest diagonal length in feet?
